stock.description: Wing Fung Group Asia Limited operates as an investment holding company, primarily focusing on the provision, installation, and interior fit-out of mechanical ventilation and air-conditioning (MVAC) systems for various properties across Hong Kong and Macau. The firm's services are delivered to main contractors and subcontractors involved in a wide array of construction endeavors, encompassing infrastructural, commercial, and residential developments. Established in 1996, the company's corporate identity shifted from Wing Fung Capital Holdings Limited to its current name, Wing Fung Group Asia Limited, in December 2016. It maintains its headquarters in Kowloon Bay, Hong Kong, and functions as a subsidiary of Wing Fung Capital Limited.
